service.method: SELECT DEPT.HOUSE_CODE , DEPT.COMPANY_CODE , DEPT.PARENT_DEPT , P_DEPT.MANAGER_ID , P_DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.POSITION , USMT.DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO FROM SDEPT DEPT INNER JOIN SDEPT P_DEPT ON P_DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND P_DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND P_DEPT.DEPT = DEPT.PARENT_DEPT INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = P_DEPT.MANAGER_ID WHERE DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT.DEPT = ${DEPT} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEPT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT DEPT.HOUSE_CODE , DEPT.COMPANY_CODE , DEPT.PARENT_DEPT , P_DEPT.DEPT FROM SDEPT DEPT INNER JOIN SDEPT P_DEPT ON P_DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND P_DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND P_DEPT.DEPT = DEPT.PARENT_DEPT WHERE DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT.DEPT = ${DEPT} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEPT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT DEPT.HOUSE_CODE , DEPT.COMPANY_CODE , DEPT.MANAGER_ID , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.POSITION , USMT.DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO FROM SDEPT DEPT INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = DEPT.MANAGER_ID WHERE DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT.DEPT = ${DEPT} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEPT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT DISTINCT SEAL.HOUSE_CODE , SEAL.COMPANY_CODE , SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.POSITION , USMT.DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC FROM SSEAL SEAL INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SEAL.SEAL_TYPE = 'C' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(SEAL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT DISTINCT SSIPD_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE , SSIPD_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE , SSIPD_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER , SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.POSITION , USMT.DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC FROM SSIPD_SEAL INNER JOIN SSEAL SEAL ON SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SSIPD_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = SSIPD_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = SSIPD_SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SSIPD_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = SSIPD_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = SSIPD_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = SSIPD_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE SSIPD_SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SSIPD_SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SSIPD_SEAL.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(SSIPD_SEAL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT DISTINCT SSEAL.HOUSE_CODE , SSEAL.COMPANY_CODE , SSEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.POSITION , USMT.DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC FROM SSEAL INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SSEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = SSEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SSEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = SSEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = SSEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE SSEAL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SSEAL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SSEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = ${SLM_NUM} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(SSEAL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT BALN.HOUSE_CODE , BALN.COMPANY_CODE , BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.POSITION , USMT.DEPT , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC FROM SBALN BALN INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = BALN.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND ( 1=1 AND BALN.CTRL_CODE = $S{CTRL_CODE1} OR BALN.CTRL_CODE = $S{CTRL_CODE2} ) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(BALN.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
